newsitem.title: USA: Mountasia recapitalizes, gets AMEX listing.
newsitem.headline: Mountasia recapitalizes, gets AMEX listing.

text.p: Mountasia Entertainment International Inc said on Wednesday it completed a recapitalization program and it plans to list on the American Stock Exchange on August 29, 1996.

Under the previously announced recapitalization, an investment group provides commitments for up to $92.7 million in equity investments and closing of $20 million in new senior credit facilities, Mountasia said.
The equity investment is initially for $40 million for 11.7 million shares of stock, increasing the total number of outstanding shares to 25.8 million.
The investment group is also entitled to receive shares upon conversion of $22.6 million of the company's outstanding convertible indebtedness, Mountasia said.
Mountasia said it restructured its nine percent subordinated convertible debentures, providing waivers to past covenant defaults and amendments to repayment provisions.
